productionDefect.observed: Two initial scenarios passed; callback_pause acknowledged authenticated member resume after actual index restart, but immutable settlement remained with waiting callback and no caller invocation until the 180s acceptance deadline. Running test source awaits a successful resume HTTP response before entering that wait.
productionDefect.mechanism: notifyCommitted only armed future group/wait deadlines. Once all groups were settled and no timer remained, resuming a paused caller did not recheck its waiting callback.
productionDefect.fix: Committed notifications coalesce a microtask that recovers persistent cooperation facts before arming deadlines. Storage failure records diagnostics and independently retries after 1s even without another notification/deadline.
productionDefect.scope: Newly reproduced callback scheduling defect; not evidence of the historical T08 SDK cancellation cause.

diagnosticEnhancement.change: Persist only bounded codes from trusted Authority/Budget/Resource error classes on failed SDK outcomes. Unknown raw native/provider errors and forged prefixed strings/objects retain generic failure. Runner cancellation signal retains precedence.

fixtureDevelopment.cooperationFirstFailure: Cross-thread source fixture omitted a required authorized member. Production ACL correctly denied it; fixture membership corrected.
fixtureDevelopment.guardDirectorySetup: Two regression shell redirections initially raced directory creation and did not execute tests; after creating the directory both checks ran successfully.
